platform.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

switch.inputs: Clean: each book's tokens [60,000, 68,192). Switch, for each of the 90 ordered pairs (x, y) of different books: x's first 6,144 of those tokens, then y's last 2,048. Noise (secondary): y's clean input with its 32 tokens after position 6,144 replaced by tokens drawn from y's own first 6,144 (default_rng(7)).
switch.measure: Next-token loss (natural log) on y's 2,048 tokens after the seam, with Glimmer's output path (head, output_multiplier, softcap; as C4 and C5), in float32 from bfloat16 logits. Excess per pair = the summed loss in the switch input minus the same tokens in y's clean input, at the same scale.
